description: This Java class 'DOMSettingsUnmarshaller' parses XML nodes to populate a 'Settings' object with configuration data such as window properties, file paths, options, table display settings, and logger configurations.

classes.name: DOMSettingsUnmarshaller
classes.description: A utility class for unmarshalling XML nodes into a Settings object, handling various configuration sections such as window, files, options, table display, colors, logger, clipboard format, and icons.

methods.name: unmarshallSettings
methods.description: Main method that processes the root XML node to populate a Settings object with various configuration sections.

methods.name: unmarshallWindow
methods.description: Parses window-related XML nodes to set window size, location, maximized state, and split pane location.

methods.name: unmarshallFiles
methods.description: Parses file-related XML nodes to set ECU definition files, image directory, and repository directory.

methods.name: unmarshallOptions
methods.description: Parses options XML nodes to set various boolean and string configuration options.

methods.name: unmarshallTableDisplay
methods.description: Parses table display settings including font, cell size, and color configurations.

methods.name: unmarshallColors
methods.description: Parses color-related XML nodes to set various color properties.

methods.name: unmarshallLogger
methods.description: Parses logger configuration XML nodes, including protocol, window size, file logging, plugins, and other logger settings.

methods.name: unmarshallColor
methods.description: Creates a Color object from XML attributes r, g, b.

methods.name: unmarshallClipboardFormat
methods.description: Parses clipboard format settings and table headers from XML nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallIcons
methods.description: Parses icon scale settings for editor and table icons from XML nodes.
